scope: Exposed-v30 metadata reprojection using the same qualified decisions, source-identity episodes and unchanged measured reps. Not a classifier accuracy improvement, automatic physical-set acquisition or fresh test.

behavior.basis: Already-confirmed grip type observed within the same owned workout set.
behavior.lateIdentification: Set annotation applies to earlier reps without changing their observed frame evidence.
behavior.missingHands: Frame-level Unknown remains; a confirmed set annotation persists.
behavior.contradictoryEvidence: Conflicting confirmed grip type or provenance leaves the automatic set label Unknown.
behavior.setBoundary: New WorkoutAnalysis/set ID starts a new metadata owner.
behavior.userCorrections: Explicit user labels override set inference; restoring automatic uses set inference.

storage: Optional setGrip annotation retained in native transport, compact summaries and merged draft records. Original per-rep coverage/labels stay measured; review identifies setEstimated provenance.

validation.androidLimitation: Android SDK unavailable; shared JVM tests pass and Android review consumes the shared report.

limitations: This is a semantic metadata reprojection of exposed v30 data, not a new held-out classifier accuracy result.
Real grip-change video qualification and Narrow/Medium width gaps from v30 remain open.
The trained RGB classifier remains offline; phone classification model is unchanged.
Width calibration is independent and unchanged.
